name: elsevier-research-mcp-utm
description: Search Scopus, get abstracts, open-access and ScienceDirect full text through the official Elsevier APIs, with institution download limits built in (UTM Library defaults: 5 articles and 100 MB per 15 min). Unofficial. Needs uv and an Elsevier API key (asked when the plugin is enabled, or from the config file).

elsevier_api_key.title: Elsevier API key
elsevier_api_key.description: From https://dev.elsevier.com (sign in, Create API Key). Stored in your system credential store. Leave empty if you already use the config file or the ELSEVIER_API_KEY environment variable.

elsevier_insttoken.title: Elsevier insttoken (optional)
elsevier_insttoken.description: Institution token from your library, for full text off-campus. Leave empty if you do not have one (UTM does not issue them).

openalex_mailto.title: Email for OpenAlex (optional)
openalex_mailto.description: Sent to OpenAlex with each request for its faster polite pool. Leave empty to skip.
